title: A/P Detail: a vendor credit shows its own date as its Due Date
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Have a vendor with one unused vendor credit, vendor credit A, on today's date.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/P Detail (Reports, then "A/P Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu).
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Expand the bucket that holds vendor credit A.
  2. Click the "Due Date" header.
  3. Click the "Due Date" header again.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The bucket opens and lists vendor credit A.
  • Its Due Date is not blank: it shows the same date as the Date column, as today.

Step 2:

  • The rows sort by Due Date, oldest first, and vendor credit A sorts by that date like any other row.
  • It is not held at the bottom.

Step 3:

  • The order reverses, newest first.
  • Vendor credit A still sorts by its date.
  • It is not held at the bottom.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11532 (Story 2, Sort by clicking any column header)

  • S2-R6: “A blank value (for example a vendor credit on A/P Unpaid Invoices, which has no due date and no Past Due) sorts to the bottom of its group in both directions. On A/P Detail a vendor credit shows its own date as its due date, as today, so it is not blank there.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
